limitations: A CUPTI stream ID is a sparse runtime identifier, not the number of source streams created or active.
The two source-stream lanes are semantic reconstruction from the captured source and exact ownership ledger; CUDA owns graph-node-to-CUPTI-stream mapping.
Bars preserve CUPTI start/end intervals; overlap does not prove simultaneous useful SM work, a dependency edge, or isolated latency.
Same-stream interval overlap may be dependency-sensitive PDL behavior and requires launch/source evidence for interpretation.
Only three consecutive post-entry steps are rendered to keep the exact all-kernel view usable; the report's statistical sections still cover all 100 steps.

source_stream_model.runtime_mapping_note: CUDA Graph replay may map nodes from either source queue onto many sparse CUPTI runtime stream IDs. The compact lanes are reconstructed from exact semantic ownership and captured source submission contexts, not inferred from numeric CUPTI IDs.
